title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES BIG GUNS
why: The card was stamped v25.22 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v25.22 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind. Its new line names the builds since: bigger guns in the hands (his order 2026-10-12), the grenade, tripwire, gun and gear foley (his sound orders) and the Forge cryo rounds.
now: The what is new card names big guns.
